product.description: The ErgoCraft ErgoSeat 2025 is a lightweight yet sturdy office chair designed for long‑term comfort. Its steel frame supports a breathable mesh back and a PU leather seat that adapts to body contours. Adjustable height, tilt, and lumbar support mechanisms allow users to fine‑tune posture. A 4‑way casters set provides smooth mobility on carpet and hard floors. The chair’s overall dimensions are 120 cm in length, 55 cm in width, and 85 cm in height, with a weight of 12 kg. It is ideal for home offices, co‑working spaces, or any environment where ergonomic seating is essential.
